meaning:
1) to cut off
1a) (Qal) to cut off
1b) (Piel) to cut off
1c) (Hiphil) to scrape, scrape off

elsewhere.note: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.
In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel;
One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
You have devised shame to your house, by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
